Activity Not As Advertised.name: Activity not as described
Activity Not As Advertised.description: The activity delivered did not match the description.
whatYouCanDo: Review the description, highlights, inclusions, photos etc in your listing to ensure they accurately reflect the real experience
Update details whenever the experience changes and check recent reviews for gaps between what you advertise and what customers receive

resources.title: Adding Description and Highlights for Your Product
Enhancing Your Product Listings With Extra Information

Guide Language Wrong or Low Proficiency.name: Language wrong or hard to understand
Guide Language Wrong or Low Proficiency.description: The guide did not speak the language originally booked for.
whatYouCanDo: Only list languages you can reliably deliver and verify each guide's language proficiency before allocating them to a booking
Remove a language from your listing immediately if you can no longer deliver it consistently

Supplier Not Responsive.name: Activity provider did not respond to customer
Supplier Not Responsive.description: The supplier was unresponsive to customer contact.
whatYouCanDo: Ensure your contact email in Account Management is correct and monitored daily
Reply to customer messages via the Messages tab within one business day and ensure guides carry a reachable phone during the activity

Unexpected Cancellation.name: Activity was cancelled without warning
Unexpected Cancellation.description: The activity was cancelled without prior warning.
whatYouCanDo: Block out dates you cannot operate as soon as you know and set cut-off times so bookings close early enough for you to plan
Notify all affected customers immediately via the Messages tab and review your participant limits regularly

resources.title: Setting up cut-off times for your product

Unclear Meeting Point Location.name: Unclear meeting point location
Unclear Meeting Point Location.description: The description of meeting point for the activity was not clear, or wrong.
whatYouCanDo: Verify your meeting point address is findable via a map app and add a meeting point photo in the Supplier Portal
Include landmarks or directions from the nearest transport stop in the Important Information section

resources.title: Introducing Meeting Point Pictures: Show Travelers Exactly Where to Meet You

Extra Charge.name: Unexpected extra charge on the activity
Extra Charge.description: Customers were unexpectedly required to pay additional charges on spot.
whatYouCanDo: Include all costs in the GetYourGuide price - no surprise charges should apply on the day
Clearly list any non-included fees (entrance, tips, equipment) in the "What's not included" section

Attraction Closed.name: Attraction or stop was closed
Attraction Closed.description: Customers arrived to find the attraction unexpectedly closed.
whatYouCanDo: Block out dates when the attraction is closed (e.g. public holidays, maintenance) as soon as you know about them
Check the attraction's opening calendar regularly and keep your availability on GetYourGuide up to date
If a closure is unexpected, inform affected customers as early as possible via the Messages tab in the Portal

Activity Oversubscribed.name: Activity was full/overbooked and customer could not join
Activity Oversubscribed.description: The activity was overbooked and customer didn't have access to it.
whatYouCanDo: Review and update your maximum participant limits for each activity option
Set up cut-off times for your product so bookings close before capacity is reached
Keep your availability in sync across all sales channels to avoid overbooking

Unsuitable For Disabled Customers.name: Unsuitable for customers with a disability
Unsuitable For Disabled Customers.description: The activity was not accessible for disabled customers.
whatYouCanDo: Clearly state all accessibility limitations (stairs, uneven terrain, no wheelchair access) in your listing
Add a dedicated Accessibility note in the Important Information tab explaining which sections of the activity are and are not accessible

Unclear Pickup Information.name: Unclear pickup information
Unclear Pickup Information.description: Information about pickup location or pickup was not provided, or it has not been confirmed by supplier.
whatYouCanDo: Use the Pickup Planner to confirm pickup times and locations with customers at least 24 hours before the activity by using our "Message Multiple Customers" feature
Include the pickup time, location, driver name, and vehicle details in your pre-activity message

resources.title: Managing Pickup Information for Your Bookings

Pickup/Guide Late or No Show.name: Driver/guide were late or did not show up
Pickup/Guide Late or No Show.description: The guide or driver arrived late or did not show up at the meeting / pick up point.
whatYouCanDo: Assign guides and drivers the day before and ensure they arrive at least 10–15 minutes early
If a delay is unavoidable, contact all affected customers immediately via Messages or your emergency contact number

_note_recaction: recActionKey is the sheet's REC ACTION (SUPER) value, which is a KEY into DEFAULT_RA_COPY in js/defect-cards.js — that module supplies the title (which may contain {count}), description, button label and icon. The sheet has no such copy; do not look for it there. Only 4 of the 11 tags carry a key, and 3 of those appear in the round-2 data.
_note_pagelink: pageLink is the sheet's PAGE LINK column: the label of the destination the recommended action sends the supplier to. It is NOT the button label on the recommended-action card, which defect-cards.js sets ("Take action").

Booking defect - Not as advertised.title: Address {count} reviews mentioning the activity was not as advertised
Booking defect - Not as advertised.description: Make sure your activity description matches the experience you provide. Include key details to set clear expectations for travelers.

Catalog - Update guide details.title: Add more guide details
Catalog - Update guide details.description: Add details about the staff who lead or assist during an activity. This helps customers know what to expect and can increase bookings.

VizOps - Add meeting point picture.title: Help customers find your meeting point by adding a photo
VizOps - Add meeting point picture.description: Recent customer feedback shows your meeting point is hard to find. A photo of the exact location reduces confusion, no-shows, and negative reviews.

Booking defect - Activity overcrowded.title: Address {count} recent reviews that mention capacity
Booking defect - Activity overcrowded.description: Review your maximum group size and update it if needed. To prevent overcrowding, ensure participants cannot book beyond the maximum group size.

_note_recactions_copy: recActions is lifted verbatim from DEFAULT_RA_COPY in js/defect-cards.js, so round 2 renders the breakdown without loading that module — its DBR-portal layout (category card with a left defect nav) is not what 2423:103908 draws. defect-cards.js is unchanged and still shared; round 2 simply does not use it. {count} is filled with the tag's distinct booking count.
